mgmt_bio.text: Dr Thomas Schinecker has been Chief Executive Officer of the Roche Group since March 2023, succeeding Severin Schwan, who moved to the chairmanship of the board. Roche's board appointed him effective 15 March 2023 from his post as CEO of the Diagnostics Division; he holds a PhD in molecular biology and had worked for Roche in leadership roles since 2003, joining the Corporate Executive Committee in August 2019. Earlier roles included General Manager of Roche Diagnostics Germany (2013-2017), Global Head of Centralized and Point of Care Solutions in Rotkreuz (2018-2019), CEO of Roche Diagnostics (2019-2022) and interim CEO of Roche Pharmaceuticals in early 2023.

sentences.quote: Enicepatide, previously CT-388, is now in an ongoing Phase 3 program. Petrelintide is moving into Phase 3 after positive Phase 2 results, and Roche is also studying a fixed-dose combination of the two.
sentences.text: In obesity, enicepatide (CT-388) showed 22.5 percent placebo-adjusted weight loss at 48 weeks in Phase II and is now in Phase III, with petrelintide following and a combination of the two under study.

thesis_pillars.text: Its top five growth drivers, Xolair, Hemlibra, Ocrevus, Phesgo and Vabysmo, sold CHF 11.0 billion, up 12 percent at constant rates. In obesity, enicepatide (CT-388) showed 22.5 percent placebo-adjusted weight loss at 48 weeks in Phase II and is now in Phase III, with petrelintide following and a combination of the two under study. Roche expects to further increase its dividend in Swiss francs, though franc strength cut reported group sales 2 percent.
